recommended_policy.name: Top five available prices by predicted hit probability
recommended_policy.price_rule: Use the best archived pregame price; probability ranking is fixed before odds are applied.
recommended_policy.value_gate: The tested ROI policy requires calibrated probability at least 1.25 times market break-even and expected ROI of at least 10%. The stricter green label also requires the 25%-haircut probability to clear break-even by 10%.

odds_archive.warning: The odds archive is too short to optimize thresholds. Policies were pre-registered before evaluation and remain provisional.

sources: MLB Stats API schedules, probable pitchers and venues
Baseball Savant sprint speed and park factors
